reviewer: Kimi actual visual comparison of exact native source, enlarged source page, complete unchanged native RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The olive/khaki peaked service cap with red band, dark visor and one tiny pale front mark is retained without inventing a detailed new emblem. Dark eyebrows, smooth face without a beard, one stern closed mouth, white pointed shirt collar, black tie and olive-brown jacket remain recognizable. The compact chin meets the collar through a short broad transition without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque dark photographic backing, overlapping warm-cream note, existing compact faint gray upper marks, mostly blank lower paper and small dark right-edge tab are retained. Full white/cyan comparisons show no interior holes, lost backing or working-matte halo outside the complete card/note silhouette.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA with genuine transparency outside the complete frame/note silhouette. The extrema and near-opacity values do not replace the actual matte review; no visible interior hole was found. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 65x67 the exact cap/collar insignia and very fine upper-lip hair are not reliably readable; no broad moustache, beard or new emblem was invented. The note marks remain indistinct visual groups, not newly invented readable words; their compact upper-paper footprint is retained without asserting exact microscopic strokes.
entries.canonical_write_boundary: Art approval and byte-identical generated_fullsize archival are complete. No concurrent generated.json write was attempted while the separate built-in owner is active.
